title: JustEnoughItems issue #4450: [Bug]: Create: Aeronautics mixin mismatch causing client crash
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by viralhysteria]
### Steps to Reproduce the Bug

The recent 19.44.0.406 update causes a client crash on world load when running the game with only Create, Create: Aeronautics and Sable enabled.
All aforementioned mods are on the latest release channel.
